title: Native bake-rs arm against the TypeScript agent
note: First live record of the native arm (roadmap scope 09): the same commit runs the TypeScript agent (base) and bake-rs -p (candidate). bake-rs carries Pi's prompt and tools (read, bash, edit, write), reaches cliproxyapi models through the read-only D25 import and DeepSeek over Chat Completions, and has no composition, roster, or delegation, so this measures two agents and its regressions are evidence, not a gate. gemini-3.8-flash-medium was not configured on the gateway on 2026-10-13, so the Gemini rows run gemini-3.8-flash-high at medium effort; they are not comparable with earlier records. Tokens: bake-rs spends about 30% fewer total tokens on Claude and DeepSeek, mostly from the smaller prompt and tool surface. Claude: requests +10 to 12% (extra check and edit rounds in shell_then_edit, stale_edit, and multi_file_edit); uncached input +47 to 58% is cache writes on each sample's first request, since the shorter prompt shares less prefix across samples, while every step still reads the cache. Gemini: requests +116%, tokens +43%, tool errors 0 -> 18: under Pi's prompt Gemini runs git commands in the fixture workspace, which is not a repository, and all 18 errors are "fatal: not a git repository"; accepted for this record and left to the prompt work in scope 10. deepseek-flash tool errors 0 -> 1: one failing check run. gpt-6.1-sol: 10/21 pairs. All 7 base failures are whitespace runaways after edit arguments that the llm-pi-ai guard stops; of the 7 candidate failures, 4 are the same runaway reaching the wall-clock limit because bake-ai has no runaway guard, and 3 are gateway errors (two "overloaded", one 5xx) with agent retry off. Porting the runaway guard to bake-ai is the follow-up these rows call for.

settings.effort: medium where the model offers it; DeepSeek runs at high, its default, having no medium

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
